Rashi on Ketubot 44a:11:1.english: And she engaged in licentious sexual relations - During betrothal, while she was a young woman.

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:11:2.hebrew: הרי זו בחנק - ואפי' נתגיירה פחותה מבת ג' שנים, דבחזקת בתולה היא. דכי כתיבא סקילה בנערה המאורסה, בישראל כתיבא, דכתיב: "כי עשתה נבלה בישראל":
Rashi on Ketubot 44a:11:2.english: She is [executed] by strangulation - And even [if] she converted when less than three years old, for she is in the presumptive status of a virgin; because when stoning is written regarding a betrothed young woman, it is written regarding Israel, as it is written: "for she has committed a disgraceful act in Israel" [Deuteronomy 22:21].

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:11:3.hebrew: אין לה לא פתח בית אביה - א"צ להוציאה אל פתח בית אביה:
Rashi on Ketubot 44a:11:3.english: She has neither the entrance of her father's house - There is no need to take her out to the entrance of her father's house.

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:11:4.hebrew: ולא מאה סלע - אם נמצא בעל שקרן ועדיו זוממין, דכולה פרשה בישראל כתיבא:
Rashi on Ketubot 44a:11:4.english: Nor one hundred sela - If the husband is found [to be] a liar and his witnesses [are] conspiring [witnesses], for the entire passage is written with "Israel."

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:12:1.english: This [daughter] is [punishable] by stoning - In the Gemara [44b], it derives it.

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:12:2.english: She is like a Jewish woman in all matters - And she has [the law of] the entrance to [her] father's house and [the right to] one hundred sela.

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:13:1.hebrew: יש לה אב ואין לה פתח בית אב - כגון שאין לו בית, ובישראלית קמיירי:
Rashi on Ketubot 44a:13:1.english: She has a father, and she does not have an entrance to [her] father's house - Such as where he does not have a house, and [it] is speaking of an Israelite [woman].

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:1:1.hebrew: הכא נמי - מדלא כתב "ואוסיפית לה מאה אמאתים קמאי", אלא כתב זמן שני לכל השלש מאות, ולא בלשון מוסיף על השטר הראשון, ש"מ אחילתיה לשעבודא קמא, ואם באת לגבות שטר השני תגבה מזמן שני. אבל גבי תוספת המוסיף בכל כתובות על מנה מאתים, כותבין בו: "ואוסיפית לה על מאי דתקון רבנן". הלכך, לא אחילתיה לשעבודא קמא, וכדקאי קאי:
Rashi on Ketubot 44a:1:1.english: Here too - Since he did not write, "And I added for her one hundred [dinars] to the first two hundred," but rather wrote a second date for all three hundred, and not in the phrasing of adding onto the first document, learn from this [that] she forgave the first lien; and if she comes to collect [with] the second document, she collects [only] from the second date. However, regarding the additional amount that one adds in all ketubot onto the [statutory] one hundred [or] two hundred, they write in it: "And I added for her onto that which the Sages instituted." Therefore, she did not forgive the first lien, and it remains as it stood.

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:2:1.hebrew: אמר מר - אדרב הונא קאי, דאמר אם באת לגבות מאתים כו':
Rashi on Ketubot 44a:2:1.english: The Master said - This refers to Rav Huna, who said, "If she comes to collect two hundred [zuz]," etc.

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:2:2.hebrew: שני שטרות - של שדה אחת, של מכר או מתנה, וכתבן ראובן לשמעון, אחד בניסן ואחד בסיון:
Rashi on Ketubot 44a:2:2.english: Two documents - [Documents] of one field, of a sale or a gift, and Reuven wrote them for Shimon, one in Nisan and one in Sivan.

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:2:3.hebrew: ביטל שני את הראשון - ואם כתב לו אחריות וטרפוה ממנו, אין גובה אלא מזמן שני. וה"נ נימא: ראשון בטיל ליה, דאחליה לשעבודיה קמא:
Rashi on Ketubot 44a:2:3.english: The second nullified the first - And if he wrote him a guarantee [of indemnity] and [creditors] seized it from him, he collects only from the date of the second [document]. And here too, let us say [that] the first is nullified, for he waived his first lien.

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:3:1.english: That if he added a palm tree in it - In the latter document.

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:3:2.hebrew: לתוספת כתביה - ולא לבטולי לקמא, אלא דאי מזמן שני אתי למגבי, ליקני עיקר ותוספת; ואי ניחא ליה בקמא משום דקדים, לא ליקני תוספת:
Rashi on Ketubot 44a:3:2.english: He wrote it as an addition - And not to cancel the first [document], rather [so] that if he comes to collect from the second date, he acquires [both] the principal and the addition; and if he prefers the first [date] because it is earlier, he does not acquire the addition.

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:3:3.hebrew: וה"נ הא אוסיף לה - דכתב לה שלש מאות:
Rashi on Ketubot 44a:3:3.english: And here too, he added for her - For he wrote three hundred [zuz] for her.

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:4:1.hebrew: ליפות כחו כתביה - ואי נמי לא אוסיף ביה, לא ביטל את הראשון, אלא דלא ליתו בני מצרא לערעורי עליה, דקיימא לן מתנה לית בה משום דינא דבר מצרא:
Rashi on Ketubot 44a:4:1.english: He wrote it to improve his rights - Even though he did not add [anything] to it, he did not nullify the first [document]; rather, [he wrote it] so that the abutting neighbors would not come to contest [it] against him, since we hold that a gift is not subject to the law of the abutting neighbor.

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:5:1.hebrew: דינא דבעל חוב - דאי אתי ב"ח וטריף ליה מיניה, קבל עליו אחריות בשטר השני, דנהדר וניגבי מיניה מעות הכתובים כאן:
Rashi on Ketubot 44a:5:1.english: The law of a creditor - For if a creditor comes and seizes it from him, [the donor] accepted liability upon himself in the second document, so that [the recipient] may return and collect from him the money written here.

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:6:1.english: What is the reason - [that the second] nullified [the first]?

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:6:2.hebrew: אודי ליה - בעל השטר שהראשון מזויף היה, ונתרצה על האחר לגבות מזמן שני:
Rashi on Ketubot 44a:6:2.english: [He] admitted to him - The holder of the document [admitted] that the first [document] was forged, and he agreed to the other [one], to collect from the second date.

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:7:1.hebrew: אורועי סהדי - החתומים בראשון, לרפרם פסולים, לרב אחא כשרים:
Rashi on Ketubot 44a:7:1.english: Impairing [the credibility of] the witnesses - Those who signed on the first [document]: according to Rafram, [they are] disqualified; according to Rav Acha, [they are] valid.

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:8:1.hebrew: ולשלומי פירי - שאכל לוקח בין זמן ראשון לזמן שני, לרפרם משלם:
Rashi on Ketubot 44a:8:1.english: And to pay for the produce - That the buyer consumed between the first date and the second date; according to Rafram, he pays [for it].

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:8:2.hebrew: ולטסקא - לפרוע מס הקרקע למלך מזמן ראשון לזמן שני. לרפרם, על המוכר לפרוע; לרב אחא, על הלוקח לפרוע:
Rashi on Ketubot 44a:8:2.english: And with regard to the land tax [taska] - [That is,] to pay the land tax to the king from the first date to the second date. [According] to Rafram, [it is] upon the seller to pay; [according] to Rav Acha, [it is] upon the buyer to pay.

Rashi on Ketubot 44a:9:1.english: What was [decided] about the marriage contract - From when does she collect [it]?

Tosafot on Ketubot 44a:10:1.hebrew: והלכתא אחד זה ואחד זה מן הנשואין - תימה לרבינו יצחק: דהשתא מסקינן דאחד זה ואחד זה מן הנשואין אע"ג דאוסיף לה, ופליגא אדרב נחמן דאמר לעיל: "אי אוסיף דיקלא לתוספת, אדעתא דתוספת כתביה ולא ביטל שני את הראשון". וזהו תימה, דהלכתא כרב נחמן בדיני, ורפרם ורב אחא איפלגו אליביה, ודייקינן נמי בשילהי הכותב (לקמן כתובות דף פט: ושם) כוותיה. ואור"י דהכא אע"ג דאיכא תוספת, ביטל את הראשון. וטעמא: משום דליכא שטר כתובה באירוסין אלא מתנאי ב"ד, הלכך נתבטל תנאי ראשון ע"י שטר; אבל לעיל דאיכא שני שטרות, כשהוסיף בשני לא ביטל את הראשון הואיל והוא בידו עדיין. וא"ת: וכיון דאיירי מילתייהו דרב הונא ורב אסי בדלא כתב לה, א"כ תפשוט מהכא הא דבעי בפ"ק דב"מ (דף יז: ושם): "אי ארוסה אית לה כתובה בדלא כתב לה"? וי"ל שאינו רוצה לפשוט אלא מן המשנה או מברייתא. ואע"ג דאיכא לאוכוחי ממילתא דר' אלעזר ב"ר שמעון ורבנן — הא נמי מימרא היא, דרב יהודה אמר שמואל אמרה משמיה ואינה ברייתא. וממתניתין ד"המארס את בתו" ליכא לאוכוחי, דאיכא לאוקמה בדכתב לה. וא"ת: ותפשוט מהא דתניא לעיל: "מודה ר' יהודה במארס את בתו ובגרה ונשאת שאין לאביה רשות בה" — וע"כ בדלא כתב לה מיירי, דאי כתב לה הויא שלו הואיל וברשותו נכתבה כדאמר לעיל; ואי ארוסה אין לה כתובה, פשיטא דאין לו בה כלום! ונראה לרשב"א דלעולם איכא לאוקמה בדכתב לה, ומיירי כגון שהוסיף לה בשעת נשואין, דסלקא דעתא הואיל ומנה מאתים שלו תוספת נמי שלו, קמ"ל:
Tosafot on Ketubot 44a:10:1.english: "And the halakha is that both this and that [take effect] from the marriage" - This is puzzling to Rabbeinu Yitzchak: for now we conclude that both this [the basic ketubah] and that [the additional amount] take effect from the marriage, even though he added for her [at the time of marriage], and this disagrees with Rav Nachman, who said earlier: "If he added a date-palm tree for the additional amount, he wrote it with the intention of [making] an addition, and the second [document] did not void the first." And this is puzzling, because the halakha follows Rav Nachman in monetary law, and Rafram and Rav Acha disputed in accordance with his view, and we also infer in the end of [the chapter] HaKotev (later, Ketubot 89b, and there) in accordance with him. And Rabbeinu Yitzchak says that here, even though there is an additional amount, it voided the first. And the reason is because there is no ketubah document at betrothal, rather [her entitlement is only] from a stipulation of the court; therefore, the first stipulation is voided by means of a document. However, earlier, where there are two documents, when he added in the second [document], he did not void the first, since it is still in [her] possession. And if you ask: Since the statements of Rav Huna and Rav Asi deal with [a case] where he did not write [a ketubah] for her, if so, resolve from here that which [the Gemara] asks in the first chapter of Bava Metzia (17b, and there): "Does a betrothed woman have a ketubah when he did not write [one] for her?" One can answer that [the Gemara there] only wants to resolve [the question] from a Mishnah or from a baraita. And even though one could prove [it] from the statement of Rabbi Elazar ben Rabbi Shimon and the Rabbis, that too is an amoraic statement, for Rav Yehuda said that Shmuel stated it in his name, and it is not a baraita. And from the Mishnah of "One who betroths his daughter" one cannot prove [it], because it is possible to establish it as [referring to a case] where he wrote [a ketubah] for her. And if you ask: Then resolve [it] from that which was taught in a baraita earlier: "Rabbi Yehuda concedes regarding one who betroths his daughter, and she became an adult and married, that her father has no authority over her" — perforce it is dealing with [a case] where he did not write [a ketubah] for her, for if he wrote [one] for her, it would be his, since it was written while under his authority, as stated earlier; and if a betrothed woman does not have a ketubah, it is obvious that he has nothing in it! And it appears to the Rashba [Rabbeinu Shimshon ben Avraham] that in fact it is possible to establish it as [referring to a case] where he wrote [a ketubah] for her, and it deals with a case such as where he added for her at the time of marriage, for one might have thought that since the [basic] one hundred or two hundred [zuz] is his, the additional amount is also his; [therefore] it teaches us [that it is not]:

Tosafot on Ketubot 44a:11:1.hebrew: הגיורת שנתגיירה בתה עמה - הא דלא נקט "הגיורת שנתגיירה" סתמא — משום דאיירי בפחותה מבת שלש, דאין דרכה להתגייר אלא עם אמה. ועוד, דאין סברא שיטבילוה על דעת ב"ד, שאין מטבילין גר קטן על דעת ב"ד אא"כ הוא תובע להתגייר, וזאת פחותה מבת ג' אין בה דעת לתבוע; להכי נקט "שנתגיירה בתה עמה", והטבילוה על דעת אמה. ועוד, משום דבעי למיתני "היתה הורתה שלא בקדושה ולידתה בקדושה":
Tosafot on Ketubot 44a:11:1.english: A female convert whose daughter converted with her - The reason [the Mishnah] did not simply state "a female convert who converted" is because it is dealing with [a girl] younger than three years old, whose way is not to convert except with her mother. And furthermore, it is not logical that they would immerse her on the authority of the court, for we do not immerse a minor convert on the authority of the court unless he requests to convert, and this one, [being] younger than three years old, does not have the understanding to request [it]; therefore it stated "whose daughter converted with her," and they immersed her on the authority of her mother. And furthermore, because it wanted to teach: "Her conception was not in sanctity and her birth was in sanctity."

Tosafot on Ketubot 44a:13:1.hebrew: אין לה פתח בית אב כו' הרי זו בסקילה - תימה, דתיקשי מהכא למ"ד בפ' נגמר הדין (סנהדרין דף מה:) "נקטעה יד העדים, פטור", דבעינן קרא כדכתיב? וי"ל דשאני הכא, דגלי קרא "ומתה" לרבות הורתה שלא בקדושה, והיינו נמי "אין לה אב". אבל קשה, דתקשי ליה מברייתא דבעיר שרובה עובדי כוכבים סוקלין אותה על שער ב"ד, דדריש "בשעריך" — ולא בשערי עובדי כוכבים; ואמאי לא פטרינן לה לגמרי? וי"ל דברוב עובדי כוכבים הוי "שעריך" שערי ב"ד, ולא שער העיר:
Tosafot on Ketubot 44a:13:1.english: "[If] she does not have an entrance to [her] father's house, etc., she is [executed] via stoning" - This is astonishing, for a difficulty should be raised from here against the one who says in the chapter [entitled] Nigmar HaDin (Sanhedrin 45b) [that if] the hand of the witnesses was severed, [the accused] is exempt, because we require the verse [to be fulfilled] as it is written! And one can say that here it is different, because the verse revealed [by stating] "and she shall die" [that it comes] to include one whose conception was not in holiness, and that is also [the meaning of] "she has no father." However, it is difficult, for a difficulty should be raised against him from the baraita [which teaches] that in a city whose majority is idolaters, they stone her at the gate of the court, for it expounds "at your gates" — and not at the gates of idolaters; and why do we not exempt her completely? And one can say that when the majority is idolaters, "your gates" is the gates of the court, and not the gate of the city.

Tosafot on Ketubot 44a:3:1.hebrew: הכא נמי בדאוסיף לה - פי' שכתב בכתובה שניה יותר מבראשונה, אבל אין לפרש שכתב "צביתי ואוסיפית כך וכך", דא"כ היתה גובה שתיהן, כדאמרינן לעיל:
Tosafot on Ketubot 44a:3:1.english: Here too, when he added for her - [This] means that he wrote in [the] second ketubah more than in the first; however, one should not explain [it to mean] that he wrote, "I desired and added such-and-such," for if so, she would collect both of them, as we say above.

Tosafot on Ketubot 44a:4:1.hebrew: משום דינא דבר מצרא - ויצניע אותו של מכר, דאם יראה שניהם — אית בה דינא דבר מצרא, דאפילו מתנה שכתוב בה אחריות אית בה דינא דבר מצרא. ונראה דאם הלוקח עצמו מצרן, דלא שייך דינא דבר מצרא — דביטל שני את הראשון. ויש מפרשים דלאו דוקא נקט "משום דינא דבר מצרא", דאפילו לא שייך דינא דבר מצרא לא ביטל שני את הראשון, דנפקא מינה לענין דרך, דאפי' למ"ד (ב"ב דף סד:) מוכר בעין רעה מוכר, נותן בעין יפה נותן:
Tosafot on Ketubot 44a:4:1.english: Due to the law of bar metzra [the abutting neighbor] - And he should conceal that [deed] of sale, for if he shows both of them, it is subject to the law of bar metzra, since even a gift in which a guarantee of indemnity is written is subject to the law of bar metzra. And it appears that if the buyer himself is an abutting neighbor, where the law of bar metzra does not apply, the second [deed] nullifies the first. And there are those who explain that [the Gemara] did not specifically state "due to the law of bar metzra," for even where the law of bar metzra does not apply, the second [deed] does not nullify the first, as there is a practical difference regarding [rights to] a path — for even according to the one who says (Bava Batra 64b) that a seller sells with a begrudging eye, a giver gives with a generous eye.

Tosafot on Ketubot 44a:6:1.hebrew: אימר אחולי אחליה לשיעבודא - תימה, מה אחליה לשיעבודא שייך גבי מתנה? ונראה לר"י, כגון שבין זמן הראשון לזמן שני קנה הנותן שדה אצל שדה הניתן, והשתא אחליה מקבל מתנה לשיעבודא, ולא יוכל לטעון דינא דבר מצרא. ועוד אומר רשב"א דנפקא מינה אם לוה נותן בין זמן הראשון לזמן שני, שיטרפו בעלי חוביו מאותה שדה [א"נ, אם יאכל הנותן פירות בין זמן ראשון לשני]:
Tosafot on Ketubot 44a:6:1.english: Say that he waived the lien - This is astonishing: what does "waiving the lien" have to do with a gift? And it appears to Ri [that this applies] in a case where, between the date of the first [document] and the date of the second [document], the giver bought a field adjacent to the field that was given; and now the recipient of the gift waived his lien [from the earlier date], so he cannot claim the law of the abutting neighbor (dina debar metzra). And Rashba further says that there is a practical difference if the giver borrowed [money] between the date of the first [document] and the date of the second [document], in that his creditors can seize [payment] from that field [alternatively, whether the giver consumes the produce between the first date and the second date].

Tosafot on Ketubot 44a:7:1.hebrew: איכא בינייהו אורועי סהדי - תימה גדולה הוא מה שפירש בקונטרס לפסול העדים, דאין יכול לפסול העדים בענין זה. ונראה לר"י, דאם יש לזה מקבל מתנה שום שטר אחר שהעדים אלו חתומים בו — מרעין ליה לשטרא, הואיל והוא מודה שהן פסולין. אי נמי, לפסול חתימתן קאמר, דאימר זיופי זייף, הואיל והוא מודה שהשטר הזה מזויף:
Tosafot on Ketubot 44a:7:1.english: "The [difference] between them [involves] impairing the witnesses" - It is a great wonder what Rashi explained, [that this means] to disqualify the witnesses, for one cannot disqualify the witnesses in this manner. And it appears to the Ri that if this recipient of the gift has any other document on which these witnesses are signed, we impair [the validity of] that document, since he [himself] admits that they are disqualified. Alternatively, [the Gemara] means to disqualify their signatures, for we say [that] he forged [them], since he admits that this [first] document is forged.
